title: Anomaly mediation in Seiberg-Witten theories
summary: We study the coupling of anomaly mediated supersymmetry breaking (AMSB) to $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric theories with $SU(2)$ gauge group. Perturbatively, $\mathcal{N}=1$ supersymmetry (SUSY) is preserved in the UV description with the AMSB terms being equivalent to a supersymmetric mass term for the adjoint chiral multiplet, as considered in the original Seiberg-Witten papers. We show, however, that nonperturbative instanton contributions break supersymmetry completely.
